title: fix(app-shell): translate "base" in the zh Studio home new-package button
body:
Fixes #13131
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, zh table `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH` only:

| key | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `engine.studio.pkg.new` | 新建软件包(可写 base) | 新建软件包(可写基座) |
| `engine.studio.landing.dupTitle` (swept sibling, same sense) | 复制这个软件包为新的可写副本(类似 duplicate base) | 复制这个软件包为新的可写副本(类似「复制基座」) |

Term choice (ruling 1): the zh table already renders a writable "base" (package) as **基座** in `engine.package.writableRequired`, `engine.packages.detail.duplicated`, `engine.packages.detail.adoptConfirm` and `engine.packages.detail.adopted`, so both rows reuse 基座 rather than introducing 基础包. No en row changed, no key added.

Sweep (ruling 2): case-insensitive `\bbase\b` over the zh portion of the file found exactly these two rows; after the fix it finds none in `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH` or any other zh table in the file.

## Pins — `zh-base-term.i18n-13131.test.ts`

- (a) `t('engine.studio.pkg.new', 'zh')` does not match `/\bbase\b/i` and contains 基座.
- (b) Census: every `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH` row is read from source (comments masked with `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`), and no row VALUE matches `/\bbase\b/i`. Exclusions: keys, comments, and identifiers such as `baseObject` (no word boundary). `\b` is the right boundary here because the target is a Latin word: a CJK neighbour is a non-word character, so 可写base would still match. Positive control: the walk returns more than 3000 rows and includes `engine.studio.pkg.new`.
- (c) Control: `t('engine.studio.pkg.new', 'en')` is still `New package (writable base)`.

## Ablation (one-time, no permanent file)

`objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` restored the old zh `engine.studio.pkg.new` row: anchor 1 -> 0, blob `ea90fd3092` -> `ec639b7f7b`. Run: (a) and (b) failed (`expected [ 'engine.studio.pkg.new' ] to deeply equal []`), (c) passed; `Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3)`. Restore: blob after restore == HEAD blob `ea90fd309248`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Verification at `270afc12b3`

- vitest (repo-root form, `--maxWorkers=1`, under the shared lock): the new test plus `artifact-locked-banner.i18n.test.ts`, `studio-locale.i18n.test.tsx` -> 3 files / 10 tests passed; the families naming the changed keys, `BuilderLanding.duplicateIdRule-11855.test.tsx` and `BuilderLanding.readonlyRoutes-11808.test.tsx` -> 2 files / 15 tests passed. The full `packages/app-shell/` directory is declared to CI.
- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` exit 0, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0 (its `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*.test.ts`).
- Lint narrowed to the two changed TS files: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` -> 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Population: both files resolve a config under `eslint.config.js` (`--print-config` succeeds). Invariance: the config sets no type-aware parser options, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Pre-tsc battery: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs` all exit 0. `check:spec-floors` exit 1 with `no-artifact` (it needs a whole-workspace build): NOT MEASURED, not caused by this diff.
